Depict the same one character: warm tan skin, vivid blue almond-shaped eyes, glossy chin-length straight black bob, straight slightly separated bangs, small nose, lightly flushed cheeks. Keep the reference face and body proportions, no new emphasis on the body. Polished detailed anime linework, restrained fine outlines, smooth rich cel shading and soft gradients consistent with the source. Head-and-shoulders portrait, face near front, relaxed self-assured very slight closed-mouth smile, both blue eyes open looking at viewer. Entire top and sides of hair inside frame with 7% margin. Face large and very clear in a small 256px icon; collar visible below. Hands outside portrait composition.
